I note the family-swap span on record is only 0.0022–0.0077 roc_auc, an order of magnitude under the shortfall, so a swap is not a plan that reaches 0.8882 either — but with 3 iterations left and the only in-family lever measured at 0.0039 of best-cut, an untried family (plus its own shrinkage path) is the largest remaining move; feature construction is not available to the executor.
